page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top left; page number at top right; no margin notes. Handwritten pencil numbers at top right are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Jam ad nostra veniamus. Ab iis autem incipiemus in quibus τὸ α initiale per aphæresin Anglis usitatissimam præscin-ditur: qualia quoque ex Latinis haud pauca.

page.notes: Greek words are rendered as best read from the scan; several accents and breathings are uncertain. The Greek entries are printed in a list, one per line. The final word "pauca" is set at the right margin, as printed.
